mods.name: Too Many Items (PE)
mods.author: MrARM
mods.description: An M button opens every block and item by category (starter kit, building, decoration, armour, tools, food, dyes, ores, spawn eggs): tap one, pick how many, Add. Also heal, survival / creative, day / night, kill, set spawn, ride any animal and an entity manager. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0.)

mods.name: Redstone Mod
mods.author: MrARM
mods.description: Redstone from before Pocket Edition had it: buttons, levers, pressure plates (stone slabs), wire and repeaters power TNT, doors and pistons. Craft parts on a stone-brick pad: tap a crafting table holding redstone. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0.)

mods.name: Heal Button
mods.author: MrARM
mods.description: A red Heal! button in the top-left corner fills your health. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0.)

mods.name: Single Player Commands PE
mods.author: Connor4898 (with CheesyFriedBacon, MrARM, Temena)
mods.description: Single Player Commands for Pocket Edition: /give, /tp, /time, /gamemode, /heal, /jump, /ascend, /descend, /explode, /magiccarpet, /coords, /setblock, /bind (a command on a button) and more - /help lists them. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: Custom Creative Inventory
mods.author: Connor4898
mods.description: /setitem <id> [damage] puts any item in your hand. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: InstaPixelArt
mods.author: Connor4898 (with Intyre)
mods.description: Tap a block with an iron sword to build a 31 x 31 pixel-art picture above it. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: Pac-Man Maze
mods.author: Connor4898
mods.description: /pmmaze builds a big Pac-Man maze around you - obsidian floor, lapis walls. It clears the land there. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: Stopwatch
mods.author: Connor4898
mods.description: Tap with an iron sword to build a block clock, tap with an iron hoe to start it counting (a beta: it counts fast). (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: TNT Cannon
mods.author: Connor4898
mods.description: /launch counts down 3-2-1 and fires lit TNT the way you look. (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0-or-later.)

mods.name: Cuboid
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Pocket Edition's first WorldEdit: tap two corners with an iron hoe, then tap holding a block - the box fills with it. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Cuboid Copy
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap two corners with an iron hoe to copy a box of blocks, tap with seeds to paste it (as often as you like). (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Cuboid Replace
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap two corners with an iron hoe, then the block to replace, then tap holding the new block. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Super Pickaxe
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap with a diamond pickaxe to dig out 11 x 11 x 11 blocks - everything but stone, grass and dirt goes to your inventory. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Jetpack
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Hold a stick to fly the way you look. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Pig Flight
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Hit any mob to ride it; hold gold ore to fly it where you look. (While it is on, hitting never hurts.) (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Sit on Stairs
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap any stairs to sit on them. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Paintbrush
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: /paintbrush turns paint mode on: whatever block you look at (up to 64 away) becomes the block you hold. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Ore of Evil
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: A glowing magenta ore (block 187) that drops purple dye - the custom blocks API's first colour demo. Get it with a give command. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Give Command
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: /give <item name> [count] [damage] adds it to your inventory, /hold puts it in your hand. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Clone Mob
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Hit a mob while holding an egg to clone it (babies stay babies). (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Colour Chat
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: /demo shows every chat colour, /onecolor <colour> <text>, /rainbow <text>. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Dyed Clay
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap clay with dye to colour it (stained clay before Pocket Edition had it); breaking it gives the dye back. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Enchanting Bench
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: An enchantment table block (240, crafted from a book, diamonds and obsidian, or /enchanttable) - tapping it opens crafting. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Item Golems
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap with an iron sword, build something, tap again - it turns into floating blocks that drift away. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Mirrored Building
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap with melon seeds to set a centre: every block you place is copied four ways around it. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Move Between Floors
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap with cake to go up a floor, with an egg to go down. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Recorder
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: /record your movements, /stop, then /play them back on yourself, a stand-in (/playsp) or a mob (/playent); /save and /load them. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Block Vehicles
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Tap a build with an iron hoe and it moves, carrying you; tap a face to steer, any other item to stop. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: World Spheres
mods.author: zhuowei (500 Internal Server Error)
mods.description: Carves part of a world (64-127 x, z) into 20 floating spheres when it loads - try it on a new world. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Instant Tree
mods.author: chad
mods.description: Tap the ground with an oak sapling to grow a tree at once. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Remove Entities
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: /removeall removes every mob and dropped item in the world. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Men Who Stare at Creepers
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: Look at a creeper and it explodes. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Grass Dye
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: Tap grass with dye to recolour it. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Lens
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: Hold a diamond to zoom in like a spyglass. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Effect Command
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: /effect <name> [seconds] [level] gives you a potion effect. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: Pistons
mods.author: zhuowei
mods.description: Piston and sticky piston blocks (199, 200) that push up to 12 blocks when powered by redstone. (Original ModPE script, CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

mods.name: MazeGen
mods.author: ChalkPE (if(Team))
mods.description: /maze <width> <height> [block data height] [turn rate] [reconnection rate] builds a random maze where you stand. (Original ModPE script, Apache-2.0.)

mods.name: Unlimited Night
mods.author: if(Team)
mods.description: Keeps it night; /nm turns it off and on (Korean messages). (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0.)

mods.name: Remove All Mobs
mods.author: if(Team)
mods.description: /md clears every mob about once a second (on by itself in creative; Korean messages). (Original ModPE script, GPL-3.0.)
